title: Fulcrum Digital is excluded on geography and scale, at 1000+ staff from a US base
content:
Fulcrum Digital's row in the Flowable sweep records two things: more than 1000 staff and a Jersey City base outside the EU. Both are disqualifiers under this brief, and together they close the row without further research.

Nothing else about the firm was gathered, which is consistent with how the sweep was run — mined from the vendor's partner page on 2026-08-18 and not imprint-swept, so only what the card printed made it onto the row. Where an exclusion applies on location and size alone, the qualitative criteria are never reached.

The note is worth keeping as a registry entry rather than a finding. If the geographic scope of the brief changes, size would still exclude Fulcrum Digital, which distinguishes it from the entries screened out on location alone.
